Messages.Author: Screaming Vermillian
Messages.Body:
Zhenga's text says something like "may recruit X additional allies and
retainers". Does this mean, if I have mr winthrop and gregory winter in
my hand, X needs to be 2, or is that just that X needs to be 1 (I have
1 additional ally AND retainer).

How does the AND function here?

Thanks.

~SV

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Screaming Vermillian wrote:
> Zhenga's text says something like "may recruit X additional allies and
> retainers". Does this mean, if I have mr winthrop and gregory winter in
> my hand, X needs to be 2, or is that just that X needs to be 1 (I have
> 1 additional ally AND retainer).

Assuming you're recruiting someone else (a Procurer, for example) and
want to use the special to grab Winthrop and Winter in addition:
2.

> How does the AND function here?

Naming a group "allies and retainers" (not "ally and retainer" or "X
additional allies and X additional retainers"). Contrast Static
Virtue's card text.

Messages.Author: Fabio 'Sooner' Macedo
Messages.Body:


I believe the former. If nothing else, because if it was the latter,
the text could be "may recruit X additional allies and X additional
retainers". It makes the text bigger somewhat, but it would still fit
in Zhenga's text space.

Fabio "Sooner" Macedo

vaguely recall that it is still a recruit ally action, so she can use
her special to put one ally from the library in play + X allies from
hand paying X blood.
